adventures.matchSource: Exact 2014 event date + exact 7:30 AM local Strava start + 10.101 km GPS recording beginning at the Illinois State Fairgrounds + SRRC historical race listing
adventures.note: The original 2014 registration page specifies a 7:30 AM 10K starting and finishing beside the Grandstand at the Illinois State Fairgrounds. The Strava activity begins at that exact local start time, starts at the fairgrounds, and records 10.101 km. The old TimingIsEverything individual results page is no longer crawler-accessible, so 1:03:09 remains a Strava elapsed-time fallback rather than an asserted official result.
